results.title: Starpost
results.overview: Scout leads a ragtag team of pilots caught in a dogfight over a hostile planet. They must outsmart enemies, dodge explosions, and escape with the intel. With her boss Hutch and partner Dodge, it's a race to survive and finish the mission.

results.title: Craftswoman: Weaving Life Whole
results.overview: Craftswoman: Weaving Life Whole is an intimate, "embodied" documentary offering a reprieve from our fast-paced and disconnected world. Directed by a filmmaker and textile artist exploring questions about what in our lives gives us a sense of wholeness, the film shifts the focus from the final product to the healing power of “process” itself. Filmed over six months under the pace of trust, the project follows four Finnish craftswomen finding meaning in the rhythm of ancestral craft. Letting go of the typical rush of film production, the filmmaker uses a slow, spacious approach to storytelling—inviting audiences to drop from their analytical minds into their felt senses, and to remember that we already have everything we need to feel whole.

results.title: Malik Mata
results.overview: Two students, cut classes and take a forbidden shortcut through an isolated field where children have mysteriously gone missing EVERY OCTOBER 15. Along the way, they encounter a strange man who begins hunting them. Trapped in the field, the two must find a way out before they become the next victims.

results.title: Lines We Cross
results.overview: Still trapped within a mysterious colony after the world’s collapse, Craig is torn between escaping or joining Sharpe in Okemba’s potentially dangerous, long-term plan to change society from within. As he confronts the trauma of being so far from home, Craig must come to terms with where he now truly belongs and whether he can find hope before it’s too late.

results.title: Claramé
results.overview: Meet Clara, a bright and innocent young girl who creates worlds from her vibrant imagination with her father. This gift captures the attention of an untrustworthy friend who is hellbent on morphing her. Through this, Clara learns a lesson about the dangers of naivety and the safety of her father’s love.

results.title: C'MON, PLEASE!
results.overview: Erol, Kenzie, and Akmal were students eating and relaxing together at a meatball stall. Suddenly, Akmal ran into his friend, Mahesa, and the two became engrossed in a long conversation. This left Erol and Kenzie feeling awkward and bored. They exchanged subtle signals, hoping to head home soon. After a long wait, Mahesa finally said his goodbyes. Erol and Kenzie felt relieved when Akmal suggested they leave, effectively bringing the tedious situation to an end.

results.title: Jaded Love
results.overview: With only three days until Lunar New Year, a superstitious girl keeps running into the same boy--is he stagnant energy she must cut off, or a sign of divine fate?

results.title: Yolanda
results.overview: Yolanda (60), a well-known podiatrist in Machalí, struggles to conceal a dark secret. When her daughter Macarena reveals her own trauma, Yolanda finds the strength she needs to confront her past.

results.title: Menudita
results.overview: Sofia (15) lives with her mother, Soledad (40), and is eagerly awaiting the arrival of her best friend from the internet, Irina (15). Both girls suffer from eating disorders. Sofia and Irina spend the day walking around the city, but when they return home, Soledad has discovered their secret.

results.title: In Journal
results.overview: A mysterious creature lives in an old Persian house and has a special journal filled with pictures of people. The creature tapes a picture of a girl to an empty page of the journal and the same girl comes to the house to shoot photos. But does she know that the creature is watching her through the window?

results.title: Satanic Panic
results.overview: Four RPG players in the 80s are about to get a dose of satanic panic

results.title: Wasteland in Embers
results.overview: 2012, Bashang Grassland, Hebei in China. A small town smothered by sand and unemployment after the coal mine shuts down. A girl with an intellectual disability lives with her grandmother, holding on to each other. When the grandmother suffers a sudden stroke, the responsibility of her care is passed around among the children, bargained over and reduced to a sum of money. The girl becomes the family's unwanted burden. After an argument, they quietly close the door and leave her on the other side.  She walks out into the wasteland alone. For the first time, the world falls silent. Warm evening light wraps around her, a sheep following close behind. She passes through ruined fields and abandoned villages. As night falls, she moves toward a room glowing red in the dark, and the light slowly takes her.  Life goes on. Only a girl who once existed slips away, without a sound.

results.title: Dialing Death
results.overview: Three mischievous teenagers pull what they think will be a harmless prank - a late-night phone call to a random number, pretending they know dark secrets about the man on the other end. What they don't realize is that they've just called a notorious serial killer who's been lying low, and now he believes they actually know something that could expose him.
